description.en: Name parts of the body, say what hurts, visit the chemist or the clinic, follow medicine instructions and wish someone a quick recovery.
description.so: Magacaw xubnaha jirka, sheeg waxa ku xanuunaya, booqo farmashiyaha ama kiliinigga, raac tilmaamaha daawada oo qof u rajee caafimaad degdeg ah.

body.en: Kenyans say Naumwa (I'm sick) or Ninaumwa na kichwa (I have a headache; lit. I'm hurt by the head). Another way is to make the body part the subject: Kichwa kinauma, Tumbo linauma, Mguu unauma, Macho yanauma. The start of the verb changes to match the noun.
body.so: Kenyaanku waxay yiraahdaan Naumwa (waan bukaa) ama Ninaumwa na kichwa (madax xanuun ayaa i haya). Hab kale waa in xubinta jirka laga dhigo falaha: Kichwa kinauma, Tumbo linauma, Mguu unauma, Macho yanauma. Bilowga ficilku wuu isbeddelaa si uu ula jaanqaado magaca.

body.en: When someone is ill, Kenyans say Pole sana (I'm so sorry), and when they leave, Ugua pole (get well soon; lit. be sick gently). To ask a sick person how they are, say Unaendeleaje? (how are you getting on?) or Unajisikiaje? (how do you feel?). The happy answer is Nimepata nafuu (I'm feeling better).
body.so: Marka qof buko, Kenyaanku waxay yiraahdaan Pole sana (aad baan uga xumahay), marka ay tagayaanna Ugua pole (Ilaahay ha ku caafiyo). Si aad qof buka u weydiiso sida uu yahay, dheh Unaendeleaje? (sidee u socotaa?) ama Unajisikiaje? (sidee dareemaysaa?). Jawaabta farxadda leh waa Nimepata nafuu (waan soo kabanayaa).

examples.so: Aad baan uga xumahay, Ilaahay ha ku caafiyo.

body.en: In Kenya a pharmacy is called a chemist, and many people ask the chemist first about small problems like a cold. With a fever, go to a kliniki and get tested, because it could be malaria. For anything serious, go to the hospitali. In Swahili you 'drink' medicine, just as in Somali: Kunywa dawa mara tatu kwa siku.
body.so: Kenya farmashiyaha waxaa loo yaqaan chemist, dad badanna dhibaatooyinka yaryar sida hargabka marka hore farmashiyaha ayay weydiiyaan. Haddii qandho ku hayso, aad kiliinig oo is baar, waayo waxay noqon kartaa duumo. Wax kasta oo culus, aad isbitaalka. Sawaaxiliga daawada waa la 'cabaa', sida Af-Soomaaliga: Kunywa dawa mara tatu kwa siku.

examples.sw: Kunywa vidonge viwili asubuhi na jioni.
examples.en: Take two tablets morning and evening.
examples.so: Laba kiniin cab subaxdii iyo fiidkii.

body.en: Kenyans say chemist where Tanzanians say duka la dawa. Kenyans usually add na after umwa: Naumwa na kichwa, while Tanzanians say Naumwa kichwa. Both are understood everywhere. Muuguzi is the standard word for nurse, but in Kenyan hospitals you will mostly hear nesi.
body.so: Kenyaanku waxay yiraahdaan chemist halka Tansaaniyaanku yiraahdaan duka la dawa. Kenyaanku badanaa umwa kadib waxay ku daraan na: Naumwa na kichwa, halka Tansaaniyaanku yiraahdaan Naumwa kichwa. Labaduba meel walba waa la fahmaa. Muuguzi waa erayga caadiga ah ee kalkaaliyaha caafimaadka, laakiin isbitaallada Kenya inta badan waxaad maqlaysaa nesi.

note.en: Plural: macho (eyes).
note.so: Wadarta: macho (indho).

note.en: Plural: masikio.
note.so: Wadarta: masikio (dhegaha).

note.en: Plural: meno (teeth).
note.so: Wadarta: meno (ilkaha).

note.en: Koo linauma = I have a sore throat.
note.so: Koo linauma = cunaha ayaa i xanuunaya.

note.en: Plural: mikono. Swahili uses one word for arm and hand.
note.so: Wadarta: mikono. Sawaaxiligu hal eray buu u isticmaalaa cudud iyo gacan.

note.en: Plural: miguu. Kwa miguu = on foot.
note.so: Wadarta: miguu. Kwa miguu = lug ahaan (cagaha).

note.en: Nina kifua can also mean 'I have a chest cold'.
note.so: Nina kifua sidoo kale waxay ka dhigan kartaa 'xabad ayaa i haysa'.

items.en: How are you getting on? (to a sick person)

note.en: Lit. 'how are you progressing?'. Kenyans ask it of someone who is ill or recovering.
note.so: Macnaha erayga: 'sidee u socotaa?'. Kenyaanku waxay weydiiyaan qof buka ama soo kabanaya.

note.en: Short for ninaumwa. Mgonjwa = a sick person, a patient.
note.so: Waa soo gaabinta ninaumwa. Mgonjwa = qof buka, bukaan.

note.en: Kenyans usually add na. You can also say Kichwa kinauma (my head hurts).
note.so: Kenyaanku badanaa waxay ku daraan na. Sidoo kale waxaad dhihi kartaa Kichwa kinauma (madaxa ayaa i xanuunaya).

note.en: The verb agrees with the body part: kichwa kinauma, tumbo linauma, mguu unauma, macho yanauma.
note.so: Ficilku wuxuu la jaanqaadaa xubinta jirka: kichwa kinauma, tumbo linauma, mguu unauma, macho yanauma.

items.en: I'm coughing / I have a cough

note.en: Kikohozi = a cough.
note.so: Kikohozi = qufac.

note.en: Nina mafua = I have a cold.
note.so: Nina mafua = hargab ayaa i haya.

items.en: I want to see a doctor

note.en: Daktari = doctor. Kumwona = to see him/her; many Kenyans simply say kuona daktari.
note.so: Daktari = dhakhtar. Kumwona = in la arko (qof); Kenyaan badan waxay si fudud u yiraahdaan kuona daktari.

note.en: Nina maumivu makali = I have severe pain. Dawa ya maumivu = painkiller.
note.so: Nina maumivu makali = xanuun daran ayaa i haya. Dawa ya maumivu = daawada xanuun-joojiska.

note.en: Kupimwa = to be tested. Nataka kupimwa malaria = I want a malaria test.
note.so: Kupimwa = in lagu baaro. Nataka kupimwa malaria = waxaan rabaa in duumo la iga baaro.

note.en: Kudungwa sindano = to get an injection.
note.so: Kudungwa sindano = in lagu duro.

note.en: For small problems Kenyans go to the chemist first. Duka la dawa (medicine shop) is also understood.
note.so: Dhibaatooyinka yaryar Kenyaanku marka hore waxay aadaan farmashiyaha. Duka la dawa (dukaanka daawada) sidoo kale waa la fahmaa.

note.en: In Swahili you 'drink' medicine, even tablets: kunywa dawa. Somali does the same: daawo cab.
note.so: Sawaaxiliga daawada waa la 'cabaa', xitaa kiniinka: kunywa dawa. Af-Soomaaliguna sidaas oo kale: daawo cab.

note.en: One tablet: kidonge.
note.so: Hal kiniin: kidonge.

items.sw: Kunywa dawa mara tatu kwa siku
items.en: Take the medicine three times a day
alt: kunywa dawa mara tatu kila siku

note.en: Lit. 'be sick gently'. Kenyans say Pole sana, ugua pole to anyone who is ill. The reply is Asante.
note.so: Macnaha erayga: 'si tartiib ah u buko'. Kenyaanku Pole sana, ugua pole waxay ku yiraahdaan qof kasta oo buka. Jawaabtu waa Asante.

note.en: Nimepona = I have fully recovered.
note.so: Nimepona = gebi ahaanba waan bogsaday.

note.en: Common around Lake Victoria and on the coast. Fever after a trip? Get tested: kupimwa malaria.
note.so: Waxay ku badan tahay agagaarka harada Victoria iyo xeebta. Qandho ma kugu dhacday safar kadib? Is baar: kupimwa malaria.

note.en: Mbu = mosquito. Lala ndani ya chandarua = sleep under a mosquito net.
note.so: Mbu = kaneeco. Lala ndani ya chandarua = ku seexo shabagga kaneecada gudihiisa.

note.en: Some visitors need a yellow fever vaccine: chanjo ya homa ya manjano.
note.so: Booqdayaasha qaarkood waxay u baahan yihiin tallaalka qandhada jaallaha: chanjo ya homa ya manjano.

note.en: Mzio = allergy; many Kenyans just say allergy. Tell the doctor or chemist before they give you medicine.
note.so: Mzio = xasaasiyad; Kenyaan badan waxay si fudud u yiraahdaan allergy. U sheeg dhakhtarka ama farmashiyaha ka hor inta aanay daawo ku siin.

note.en: Private hospitals often ask for insurance or payment before treatment.
note.so: Isbitaallada gaarka loo leeyahay badanaa waxay weydiiyaan caymis ama lacag ka hor daaweynta.

note.en: -m- = him or her: nitampeleka = I will take him/her.
note.so: -m- = isaga ama iyada: nitampeleka = waan geyn doonaa (isaga ama iyada).

items.en: He/She has been admitted to hospital

note.en: Lit. 'has been made to lie down'. Kulazwa = to be admitted.
note.so: Macnaha erayga: 'waa la jiifiyey'. Kulazwa = in isbitaal la dhigo.

note.en: Visiting the sick matters a lot in Kenyan families. Bring fruit or juice and say Pole, ugua pole.
note.so: Booqashada bukaanka aad bay muhiim ugu tahay qoysaska Kenya. Keen miro ama casiir oo dheh Pole, ugua pole.

lines.en: Omar, how are you doing today?
I'm sick. I have a fever and a cough.
lines.so: Waan bukaa. Qandho ayaa i haysa, waanan qufacayaa.

lines.en: So sorry! Does your head hurt too?
lines.so: Aad baan uga xumahay! Madaxuna ma ku xanuunayaa?

explain.en: 'How are you getting on?' – 'I have a stomach ache.'
explain.so: 'Sidee isu aragtaa?' – 'Calool xanuun ayaa i haya.'

lines.en: My stomach has hurt since yesterday.
lines.so: Calooshu way i xanuunaysay tan iyo shalay.
Hagaag. Marka hore waan ku baarayaa.

lines.sw: Hapana, si lazima. Utakunywa dawa tu.
lines.en: No, it's not necessary. You'll just take medicine.
lines.so: Maya, looma baahna. Daawo oo keliya ayaad cabbi doontaa.

explain.en: 'Where does it hurt?' – 'Here, in my back.'

meaning.en: The doctor will give you an injection now.

lines.sw: Habari. Nina mafua na nakohoa. Una dawa?
lines.en: Hello. I have a cold and a cough. Do you have medicine?
lines.so: Iska warran. Hargab ayaa i haya, waanan qufacayaa. Daawo ma haysaa?

lines.sw: Ndiyo. Kunywa vidonge hivi mara tatu kwa siku.
lines.en: Yes. Take these tablets three times a day.
lines.so: Haa. Kiniinnadan maalintii saddex jeer cab.
Laba boqol. Ilaahay ha ku caafiyo!

question.en: How often must Abdi take the tablets?
question.so: Immisa jeer ayuu Abdi qaadanayaa kiniinnada?

explain.en: 'So sorry, get well soon.' – 'Thank you very much.'
explain.so: 'Aad baan uga xumahay, Ilaahay ha ku caafiyo.' – 'Aad baad u mahadsan tahay.'

meaning.en: Take the medicine twice a day.

explain.en: 'Are you allergic to any medicine?' – 'Yes, to penicillin.'
explain.so: 'Ma jirtaa daawo aad xasaasiyad ka qabto?' – 'Haa, penicillin.'

meaning.en: Sleep under a mosquito net every night.
meaning.so: Habeen kasta ku seexo shabagga kaneecada gudihiisa.

prompt.so: Waxaan rabaa in duumo la iga baaro

lines.sw: Farah, mtoto ana homa kali tangu asubuhi.
lines.en: Farah, the child has had a high fever since this morning.
lines.so: Farah, ilmaha qandho kulul ayaa haysay tan iyo subaxdii.

lines.en: Oh no! I'll take him to hospital right now.
lines.so: Ka xumahay! Hadda isla markiiba isbitaalka ayaan geynayaa.

options.so: Daawo ayuu farmashiyaha ka iibsan doonaa

explain.en: 'Grandpa has been admitted to hospital.' – 'I'm so sorry. I'll visit him tomorrow.'
explain.so: 'Awoowe isbitaal ayaa la dhigay.' – 'Aad baan uga xumahay. Berri ayaan booqan doonaa.'
